scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-warnings NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 pnpm run build:tokens && turbo run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:tokens && pnpm run build:ts && turbo run bundle
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && pnpm run e2e
scripts.openapi:validate: pnpm run openapi:build && pnpm run openapi:lint
scripts.precommit: pnpm run api:types && pnpm -w run build:ts && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.ci: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.test:all:docker: echo 'Running @entrip/api in container and shared on host' && pnpm -C packages/shared test && docker exec entrip-api-v2-local sh -lc 'cd /app/packages/api && pnpm test'
scripts.test:api:container: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --entrypoint '' -e RATE_LIMIT_PREFIX=ci-$(date +%s) -e CACHE_DISABLE_IN_TEST=true -e TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://entrip:entrip@postgres:5432/entrip_test -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://entrip:entrip@postgres:5432/entrip_test api-v2 sh -lc 'cd /app/packages/api && pnpm test --runInBand'
scripts.test:full:container: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --entrypoint '' -e RATE_LIMIT_PREFIX=ci-$(date +%s) -e TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://entrip:entrip@postgres:5432/entrip_test -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://entrip:entrip@postgres:5432/entrip_test api-v2 sh -lc 'set -e; cd /app; echo :: @entrip/shared ::; mkdir -p /app/packages/shared/reports/junit; JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=/app/packages/shared/reports/junit JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=junit.xml pnpm exec jest --config packages/shared/jest.config.js --runInBand --verbose --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit --coverage; echo :: @entrip/ui ::; mkdir -p /app/packages/ui/reports/junit; JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=/app/packages/ui/reports/junit JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=junit.xml pnpm exec jest --config packages/ui/jest.config.js --runInBand --verbose --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit --coverage; echo :: @entrip/web ::; mkdir -p /app/apps/web/reports/junit; JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=/app/apps/web/reports/junit JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=junit.xml pnpm exec jest --config apps/web/jest.config.js --runInBand --verbose --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit --coverage; echo :: @entrip/api ::; cd /app/packages/api; mkdir -p /app/packages/api/reports/junit; JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=/app/packages/api/reports/junit JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=junit.xml pnpm exec jest --runInBand --verbose --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit --coverage'
scripts.test:full:container:nocache: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --entrypoint '' -e CACHE_DISABLE_IN_TEST=true -e RATE_LIMIT_PREFIX=ci-$(date +%s) -e TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://entrip:entrip@postgres:5432/entrip_test -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://entrip:entrip@postgres:5432/entrip_test api-v2 sh -lc 'set -e; cd /app; echo :: @entrip/shared ::; mkdir -p /app/packages/shared/reports/junit; JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=/app/packages/shared/reports/junit JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=junit.xml pnpm exec jest --config packages/shared/jest.config.js --runInBand --verbose --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit --coverage; echo :: @entrip/ui ::; mkdir -p /app/packages/ui/reports/junit; JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=/app/packages/ui/reports/junit JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=junit.xml pnpm exec jest --config packages/ui/jest.config.js --runInBand --verbose --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit --coverage; echo :: @entrip/web ::; mkdir -p /app/apps/web/reports/junit; JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=/app/apps/web/reports/junit JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=junit.xml pnpm exec jest --config apps/web/jest.config.js --runInBand --verbose --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit --coverage; echo :: @entrip/api ::; cd /app/packages/api; mkdir -p /app/packages/api/reports/junit; JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=/app/packages/api/reports/junit JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=junit.xml pnpm exec jest --runInBand --verbose --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit --coverage'
scripts.db:reset:v1: docker exec entrip-api-local sh -lc 'cd /app/apps/api && yes | pnpm exec prisma db push --accept-data-loss --force-reset'
scripts.db:seed:v1: docker exec entrip-api-local sh -lc 'cd /app/apps/api && pnpm exec prisma db seed'
